// Somewhat redundantly fix TOXType's underlying type to int, so that
// SwTOXEntryTabPage (sw/source/ui/index/cnttab.cxx) can initialize
// aLastTOXType.eType to (TOXTypes)USHRT_MAX without causing -fsanitize=enum:

{
    TOX_INDEX,
    TOX_USER,
    TOX_CONTENT,
    TOX_ILLUSTRATIONS,
    TOX_OBJECTS,
    TOX_TABLES,
    TOX_AUTHORITIES,
    TOX_BIBLIOGRAPHY,
    TOX_CITATION
};
